chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 531 — Ji Ning's Vow to Protect His Family & The Empyrean Puppet Lore Bomb
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning returns from battle to a home prepared by Yu Wei, swears to protect her and their unborn child, and receives shocking intelligence from the Xia Emperor about the Seamless Gate's unbeatable puppet technology.
og_title: The Calm Before the Storm — A Vow in the War of the Three Realms
og_description: Against the backdrop of an interstellar war, Ji Ning finds stillness at Yu Wei's side—and learns that the Seamless Gate holds an unbeatable advantage in war machines.
twitter_title: Home, Heart, and Horror — Ji Ning's Quietest Chapter
twitter_description: A warm meal, a silent vow, and a terrifying lore drop about Empyrean God puppets. The calm before the storm has never felt so heavy.

lore_anchors.definition: A massive war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals as a foundation and 1,000 Celestial Immortals as a framework, manifesting a temporary divine spirit of god-tier durability; bestowed by Xingtian the True God.
Celestial Immortal-controlled mechanical war-gods that are nearly as powerful as a Xingtian formation but require far fewer immortals (150) to operate at peak efficiency.

The supreme divine ability beneath the True God level, trained by mastering nine cycles of body refinement; requires enormous treasure resources to advance but provides indestructibility without consuming divine power.

A specialized faction within the Seamless Gate solely dedicated to the forbidden art of puppet-forging; its core formation diagrams are so well-guarded that even True Gods and Daofathers of the Nuwa Alliance have failed to steal them.
A legendary, high-grade immortal pill used to fuel the breakthrough of the Arcane Art; requires a fifth-cycle foundation to withstand its medicinal power.
